extraction.text:
Naman H Davey

namanharish13@gmail.com LinkedIn.com/Naman Davey +91- 9176786736

Professional Profile Operations professional with 5 years of experience in Agency Securities Lending, securities settlements, custody operations, reconciliations, and exception management across global banking environments. Specialized in collateral management, trade settlements, exposure tracking, and SWIFT instructions (MT540- 548,599, MT202MT380), with proven ability to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of securities loans while ensuring timely collateralization, income tracking, and resolution of settlement breaks. Equally adept at broader custody and reporting functions, including monitoring trade lifecycles, preparing operational reports, and supporting risk and control frameworks under strict SLAs. Skilled in coordinating with trading desks, brokers, and sub-custodians to maintain operational accuracy, while driving process improvements and compliance initiatives that reduce risk and enhance efficiency in fast-paced global markets. Career Summary

Team Leader, Standard Global Business Services

Sept 2025– Present

RESPONSIBILITIES –SECURITY SERVICE OPERATIONS, CUSTODY SETTLEMENTS



Integral member of the Custody Settlements team supporting African markets, managing end-to-end trade processing, repair, capture, clearing, and settlement across Equity, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, and Fixed Deposit transactions.

Acting as a point of contact in absence of Manager and responding to client/ counterparty escalations within

the specified TAT.

Verified and amended client instructions based on SWIFT messages (MT599), ensuring compliance with trade

processing protocols.

Monitored failed trade settlements, conducted root cause analysis, and implemented corrective actions to

mitigate settlement risks.

Executed and validated cash processing operations, handling transactions such as Bank Transfers (BT), Telegraphic Transfers (TT), Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS), and SWIFT payments (MT103, MT202, MT380).

Processed foreign exchange (FX) transactions for DVP and RVP trades post-settlement, ensuring adherence to client instructions configured in internal systems.

Managed client escalations, inquiries, and dispute resolution, collaborating with internal stakeholders and



external custodians to ensure service excellence. Implemented process automation initiatives, optimizing workflows and improving Straight-Through Processing (STP) rates for equity transactions in Ghana market.

Conducted AML compliance monitoring, sanctions screening, and risk assessments to ensure timely release of

payments in adherence to regulatory policies.

Currently acting as a Process Checker for all SWIFT-related transactions, ensuring accurate validation of securities and cash instructions in line with zero-error quality standards.

Ensured the punctual and accurate transfer of shares from brokers to clients, minimizing the likelihood of

failures.

SENIOR ASSOCIATE - AGENCY LENDING SETTLEMENTS & COLLATERAL MANAGEMENT - BNP PARIBAS - APR 2021– Sept 2025



Integral member of the Agency Lending team, handling both collateral and trade life cycle management for global securities lending activities.

• Collaborated with trading desks, dealers, and custodians to ensure accurate and timely settlement of

securities lending and return transactions.

Monitored and ensured timely collateral movements, including Cash (MT202) and non-Cash (Equity & Fixed

Income) exposures; collaborated with counterparties to manage daily exposure coverage.

Executed daily margin calls to borrowers based on collateral exposure shortfalls, ensuring compliance with market cut‑off times and strict SLA requirements.

Closely tracked exposure coverage and mark-to-market (MTM) fluctuations, proactively engaging with

counterparties to ensure timely settlement of collateral obligations.

Managed cash (MT202) and non-cash (equity/fixed income) collateral movements, ensuring accurate

transfers and timely reconciliations.

Documented manual SWIFT messages (MT540-548,599) and trade instructions to maintain operational

accuracy and audit readiness.

Validated collateral sufficiency across borrower accounts through exposure-versus-holdings analysis, initiating

corrective actions to maintain required margins in accordance with internal risk frameworks.

Performed pre-matching and post-settlement reconciliations, aligned internal books with sub-custodians and

brokers, ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.

Reviewed corporate action events, including restrictions for ASX200 and beyond, coordinating with borrowers

to validate eligibility and act accordingly.

Demonstrated strong organizational skills by independently managing multiple deadlines and high-value

deliverables across functions.

Education

2017-2020

Bachelors in Commerce, D.G. Vaishnav college, Chennai

Currently Pursuing MBA(Finance) Pondicherry University Aug 2025 - Present

Technical skills

MS office, Reconciliation Tools, Swift Message (MT540 series, MT202, MT103, MT380)

Achievements

Received appreciation from senior management for seamless collateral and trade settlement coverage

during resource shortages.

Designed and implemented an internal validation tool to flag non-eligible collateral, reducing operational risk and increasing process control.
